ns2:section.sectionText: NOTE--Majority of seats held for Community Health and iHealth majors until July 10. Although major restrictions will be lifted on July 10, the department will continue to have some seats reserved for CHLH majors through the 10th day of class. No overrides will be given. This section will have distributed classroom attendance with supplemental instruction. You will receive an email from the instructor with specific attendance directives.
